message: Astra: Within Fa na’s investigation, does your latest scene actually contain two audit requests, or does that distinction exist only in your plan? Which sentence deserves closer inspection before deciding? Why would more thinking clarify the action sequence better than an informative attempt now, and what unresolved uncertainty could make acting premature? What textual evidence would justify either choice? Could you briefly state in English what you found, what remains uncertain, and what you intend to do next, then carry out your choice?
